description: ADR-003a Issue Y regression guard. The customer was pitched satisfyer-pro-2 in a prior turn (it appears in pitchedHandlesLog). When they ask 'show me some alternatives,' the dedup filter must prevent satisfyer-pro-2 from appearing in the new result set. Emma must surface a different handle. This guards against the five-turn repeat-pitch failure observed in Phase 0.5.
priorSummary: Customer is looking for a first vibrator. Emma recommended the Satisfyer Pro 2 last turn.

turns.text: hmm not sure, show me some alternatives

notes: pitchedHandlesLog contains ['satisfyer-pro-2']. The dedup filter must drop the satisfyer-pro-2 card from the result set. Emma receives only we-vibe-tango-x and dame-eva-ii as options and must pitch one of those, not satisfyer-pro-2.
